text:
Introduction
It is a Layer 2+ 1G/2.5G Hybrid rate Managed Ethernet PoE Switch featuring
high-quality Network and PoE Chip
seamless connection for 10/100/1000M Ethernet
with LED indicators to display the connection and operation of equipment
easy to manage and maintain
802.3af and 802.3at standard for each PoE port
intelligent detection of powered devices
power the devices that comply with the IEEE802.3af or IEEE802.3at standards
transmit only data to non-PoE devices
It can be  used as core layer, distribution layer, and access layer switch for various business network applications
Key Features
4*1G/2.5G SFP uplink slots + 24*10/100/1000M RJ45 ports and 1*RJ45 console port for basic management and setup
Complies with IEEE 802.3at, IEEE802.3af standard. Max output power can reach 30W(PoE+)
Smart and standard PoE chipset to detect the PD equipment automatically, never burn the PD equipment
Layer 3 features: Support IPv4/IPv6 static routing, DHCP server
Layer 2 features: VLAN; ERPS, STP/RSTP/MSTP; Link aggregation, IGMP snooping, port mirroring, QinQ, 802.1X, port isolation, RMON, NTP client, DHCP snooping/client, Ping/Tracert test, ACL, QoS and SFP DDM function
Management and maintenance: IPv4 and IPv6 management; Support Web, SNMP, CLI, Telnet/SSH management method; Support user management, system log, configuration upload/download through web interface, firmware upgrade via HTTP/TFTP
Support G.8032 ERPS protocol, recovery time≤20ms
Support 4KV Power surge protection, IEC 61000-4-5  Level X(8/20us)
Support 4KV Ethernet ports surge protection, IEC 61000-4-5 Level 4(10/700us)
Support fan speed control
Operation temperature: 0℃ ~+ 50℃
Specification
Product Name	28 Port Hybrid Rate Rack Type Managed Ethernet PoE Switch
Port	24*10/100/1000M PoE UTP RJ45 / 4*1G/2.5G SFP Ports / 1*RJ45 Console Port(115200,8,N,1)
Network Protocol	IEEE 802.3 10Base-T Ethernet / IEEE 802.3u 100Base-TX Ethernet / IEEE 802.3ab 1000Base-T Ethernet / IEEE 802.3z 1000Base-X Ethernet / IEEE802.3x Flow Control and Back Pressure / IEEE 802.1D Spanning Tree Protocol / IEEE 802.1w Rapid Spanning Tree Protocol / IEEE 802.1Q VLAN / ITU-T G.8032 ERPS / IEEE 802.1X Port Authentication Network Control / IEEE 802.1ab LLDP / IEEE 802.3ad LACP / IEEE 802.3af
IEEE 802.3at
Fiber Option	SFP Plug-able Module(LC), 1G or 2.5G based / Default speed is 1G, 2.5G speed needs to be manually configured in the Web UI / It is NOT supporting auto-detecting, manual configuration is required / It is NOT supporting 100M optical module nor configurable / SM: 1310nm/1550nm, 20Km; 1490nm/1550nm, 40~100Km / MM: 1310nm, 2Km; 850nm, 500-meter
Switching Capacity	68Gbps
Packet Forwarding Rate	101Mpps
MAC Address Table	16K
VLAN	4K
Buffer	12Mbit
Forwarding Delay	<5us
Jumbo Frame	Support 10Kbytes
MDX/MIDX	Support
PoE Protocol	IEEE802.3af(15.4W), IEEE802.3at(30W) / Remark: auto-sensing PD standard and supply compatible power
PoE Distance	meter / Remark: A PoE extender is required for longer PoE transmission
PoE Wiring	Mode A/End-span / 1/2(+), 3/6(-)
PoE Budget	440W(850W optional) / Max PoE output: 30W/port
Power	AC100-240V Input, Single Power Input(default) / Dual Power Input is optional, support fan monitoring/dual PSU status monitoring / Fan monitoring: support normal/failure mode / Fan speed: support high/low speed mode, configuring fan speed is NOT supported
PoE Output	DC48V, Active PoE / Remark: DC24V passive PoE is NOT supported / A PoE splitter is required if the powered device receives DC24V voltage
Total Power Consumption	Full loading without PoE≤24W
Over-current Protection	Support
Watchdog	Support
MTBF	100,000 hours
Certification	CE/FCC/RoHS/Reach/UKCA
Working Environment	Working Temperature: 0℃~50℃ / Storage Temperature: -10℃~70℃ / Working Humidity: 10%~90%, non-condensing / Storage Temperature: 5%~95%, non-condensing
LED Indicator	PWR(Power indicator) / On: power status is normal
Off: power off or power connection failure / S(System indicator) / On: Normal operation / Off: Connection failure / Blinking: Device initialization / Ethernet Port / Green Indicator / On: port link up / Off: port link down / Blinking: data is in normal transmission / Yellow Indicator / PoE ports / On: PoE working / Off: PoE not working / Fiber port, Green Color / On: port link up / Off: port link down / Blinking: data is in normal transmission
Packing Information
1pc switch(neutral device)
1pc power cable(standards vary across countries)
1pc user manual(including QIG information)
1pc console cable(USB 2.0 to RJ45 connector)
1pair mounting brackets(rack mountable)
Please know that there is NOT a warranty card in the packing box
A “Warranty Certificate” will be issued to indicate the order information and warranty coverage

Inner box size: 525*390*95mm
Product weight: 4.2Kg
Packing weight: 5Kg
Master box size: 545*495*420mm
Packing quantity: 5Pcs
Packing weight: 26Kg
